title: LatentLoop: Scaling Looped MoE Models with Asymmetric Compute Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine parameter reuse with sparse computation to improve performance under matched budgets. Prior work demonstrates that different loop visits can play different roles even when they share parameters. To probe the contributions of different loop visits, we learn separate residual coefficients in a model that applies a shared block twice, observing a smaller scale in the first visit. Fixed coefficient experiments show that reducing the first visit's scale preserves or improves performance, whereas the same reductions to the second hurt it. This asymmetry motivates us to explore asymmetric compute allocation. We propose \textbf{LatentLoop}, which compresses the first visit's sequence, retains full resolution in the second, and reallocates saved computation to increase the hidden size. translated_title: LatentLoop：通过非对称计算分配扩展循环MoE模型
translated_abstract: 循环混合专家模型将参数重用与稀疏计算相结合，以在匹配的计算预算下提升性能。先前的研究表明，即使共享参数，不同的循环访问也可以发挥不同的作用。为了探究不同循环访问的贡献，我们在一个将共享模块应用两次的模型中学习独立的残差系数，观察到第一次访问的尺度较小。固定系数实验表明，降低第一次访问的尺度能够保持甚至提升性能，而对第二次访问进行相同的削减则会损害性能。这种非对称性促使我们探索非对称的计算分配方案。我们提出LatentLoop，该方法压缩第一次访问的序列，在第二次访问中保留完整分辨率，并将节省下来的计算重新分配用于增大隐藏层维度。我们进一步学习第一次访问对完整序列的更新强度，并在各次访问之间共享MoE权重（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现循环MoE模型的两次循环访问存在非对称性，并提出LatentLoop方法，通过压缩第一次循环访问的序列、保留第二次的完整分辨率，并将节省的计算重新分配以增大隐藏层维度，从而在匹配预算下提升模型性能。
en_tdlr: LatentLoop exploits the asymmetry between loop visits in looped MoE models by compressing the first visit's sequence while retaining full resolution in the second, reallocating saved computation to increase hidden size and improving performance under matched budgets.
